newsitem.title: USA: Schott Glaswerke FY96 sales flat at $1.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: Schott Glaswerke FY96 sales flat at $1.8 bln.

text.p: German-based Schott Glaswerke on Thursday said its sales in the fiscal year ended September 30 were $1.8 billion (DM 2.7 billion), little changed from the previous year.
Sales at the privately held company's businesses outside Germany increased eight percent, while sales at its German units fell six percent because of economic conditions in that country, Schott said.

Sales at its U.S. unit, Schott Corp, fell two percent to $328 million, but operating profits increased on its performance in optical glasses, fiber optics for message signs and lighting applications, and special glasses for appliances.
As a private company, the company does not disclose its profits, a spokeswoman said.
